professionalSummary.text: Product Manager at Tidewater APIs with experience writing API specifications, running early-access programmes, taking features to general availability, preparing developer communications, and collaborating on pricing with the commercial team.
professionalSummary.witness: Product Manager, Tidewater APIs, March 2021 to July 2024: wrote the specification for per-key rate limiting with two platform engineers, including the 429 response format, retry headers and versioning rules, reviewed by the architecture group.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote API specifications with platform engineers, including error and versioning behaviour, reviewed by architecture group.
experienceHighlights.witness: Product Manager, Tidewater APIs, March 2021 to July 2024: wrote the specification for per-key rate limiting with two platform engineers, including the 429 response format, retry headers and versioning rules, reviewed by the architecture group.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran a six-week early-access programme for rate limiting with nine customers on a separate preview endpoint, holding weekly feedback calls and logging requests on the product board.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran a six-week early-access programme for rate limiting with nine customers on a separate preview endpoint, holding weekly feedback calls and logging requests on the product board.

experienceHighlights.text: Took rate limiting to general availability on all production endpoints after release review signed off the launch checklist, chaired post-launch review with engineering and support.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took rate limiting to general availability on all production endpoints on 21 February 2024 after the release review signed off the launch checklist, and chaired the post-launch review three weeks later with engineering and support.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote changelog, migration guide, and customer email for rate limiting; developer relations reviewed each before publication, with API reference pages updated to match.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the changelog entry, the migration guide and the customer email announcing rate limiting; developer relations reviewed each before publication, and the API reference pages were updated to match.

experienceHighlights.text: Supplied per-plan usage data to commercial team for pricing tier limits, wrote internal FAQ for sales team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supplied per-plan usage data to the commercial team, which then set the limits attached to each pricing tier, and wrote the internal FAQ for the sales team.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Post-launch review for rate limiting included signed launch checklist, production release date of 21 February 2024, 429 response counts by plan for first three weeks, and two follow-up actions agreed with engineering, both closed within a month.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the post-launch review for rate limiting, including the signed launch checklist, the production release date of 21 February 2024, counts of 429 responses by plan for the first three weeks and two follow-up actions agreed with engineering, both closed within a month.

skills.text: API specifications, early-access programmes, general availability releases, developer communications, pricing collaboration.
skills.witness: Product Manager, Tidewater APIs, March 2021 to July 2024: wrote the specification for per-key rate limiting with two platform engineers, including the 429 response format, retry headers and versioning rules, reviewed by the architecture group.
